subtitles.zh: 我认为总体而言，苹果首次为家庭呈现了一套连贯、完整的端到端解决方案。
subtitles.en: I think for the most part, Apple presented for the first time a coherent, complete end-to-end solution for the home.

subtitles.zh: 欢迎来到Power On。我们聊苹果和消费科技世界。

subtitles.en: We will also break down Apple's a late October event where the company's planning to introduce it's a long anticipated touchscreen MacBook, so stay tuned for that and much more.

subtitles.zh: 克里斯，很多听众在线看过苹果活动，也读过相关报道，
subtitles.en: Chris, so a lot of people listening to the show have watched Apple events online, have read about Apple events,

subtitles.zh: 可能还想去现场参加苹果活动。
subtitles.en: and probably wanted to go to an Apple event.

subtitles.zh: 但你参加过很多次。能讲讲你的一天吗，从清晨开始，带我们回顾活动。
subtitles.en: But you've been to many. Can you just tell us about your day, just start from the wake up, maybe not from the wake up, but start from the early morning. Yeah, start from the early morning and talk us through the event.

subtitles.zh: 让我们感觉身临其境。进展如何？你见到了谁？都告诉我。
subtitles.en: Make us feel like we were there. How did it go? Who did you see? Tell me everything.

subtitles.zh: 是的，把这称为活动有点有趣，因为它其实不是通常意义上的苹果主题演讲或新产品发布。
subtitles.en: Yeah, so it's kind of fun to call this an event because it really wasn't one, and like the usual sense of an Apple keynote or like new product thing.

subtitles.zh: 对于不了解的人来说，这更像是一次新家居视图的导览。

subtitles.zh: 我认为总体而言，苹果首次为家庭呈现了一套连贯、完整的端到端解决方案。

subtitles.zh: 欢迎来到Power On。我们聊苹果和消费科技世界。
subtitles.en: Welcome to Power On. We talk about Apple and the world of consumer tech.

subtitles.zh: 我是彭博社的马克·欧文，今天有两位同事克里斯·韦尔奇和弗拉德·萨沃夫加入。
subtitles.en: I'm Mark Irwin from Bloomberg and today I'm joined by two of my colleagues, Chris Welch and Vlad Savov.

subtitles.zh: 当然，我们将深入解析苹果盛大的欢迎回家智能家居发布活动，公司推出了HomeView、新款Apple TV和更新的HomePod Mini。
subtitles.en: And of course, we will be breaking down Apple's big welcome home, smart home launch events, where the company introduced the home view, new Apple TV, and updated HomePod Mini.

subtitles.zh: 我们还将解析苹果十月下旬的活动，公司计划推出期待已久的触屏MacBook，敬请关注更多内容。
subtitles.en: We will also break down Apple's a late October event where the company's planning to introduce it's a long anticipated touchscreen MacBook, so stay tuned for that and much more.

subtitles.zh: 克里斯，很多听众在线看过苹果活动，也读过相关报道，

subtitles.zh: 但你参加过很多次。能讲讲你的一天吗，从清晨开始，带我们回顾活动。
subtitles.en: But you've been to many. Can you just tell us about your day, just start from the wake up, maybe not from the wake up, but start from the early morning. Yeah, start from the early morning and talk us through the event.

subtitles.zh: 让我们感觉身临其境。进展如何？你见到了谁？都告诉我。
subtitles.en: Make us feel like we were there. How did it go? Who did you see? Tell me everything.

subtitles.zh: 是的，把这称为活动有点有趣，因为它其实不是通常意义上的苹果主题演讲或新产品发布。
subtitles.en: Yeah, so it's kind of fun to call this an event because it really wasn't one, and like the usual sense of an Apple keynote or like new product thing.

subtitles.zh: 对于不了解的人来说，这更像是一次新家居视图的导览。
